_comment: Unit overrides. Key = unit key (BATTLE_TANK, ARTILLERY, ...). 'health' is a confirmed alias; 'fields' addresses any declared UnitType field by name. SEMANTICS CONFIRMED in 17: g=health, m=speed (NOT l), n=altitude, s=damage, t=range, D=sight/attack range, H=capacity. Do not write o/E/J (computed). UPPER-CASE fields need a trailing underscore (D_ H_ ...) because libGDX JsonValue lookup is case-insensitive.
